title: Staged traffic replay matrix and rollback automation for runtime/console/API
creator: Priya Shah
description: Objective: design and deliver a reusable launch pattern that uses staged traffic replay (controlled replay of production-like traffic into canaries) plus automated rollback triggers to reduce detection-to-rollback time for model/runtime/console/API changes. Scope: 1) a decision matrix that maps change types (runtime kernel update, model quantization, console UI change, API contract tweak) to an appropriate replay shape (percentage, user cohorts, latency focus), monitoring signals, and rollback thresholds; 2) an automation layer that wires detection to an execution path (pause, throttle, rollback variant, route to fallback model); 3) runbooks and dashboards for on-call and release owners. Out of scope: full integration with Dedicated capacity reservation UI (follow-up ticket). Success criteria: a) run a staged replay for a non-trivial model rollout with automated rollback triggering in internal canary within 72 hours from rollout start; b) reduce mean time to rollback for qualifying incidents by >=40% in pilot; c) teams can reuse the matrix with less than 2 hours of onboarding time. Acceptance: documented matrix, automation playbook, two rehearsal runs, monitoring dashboards with alerting, and a postmortem template for rehearsals.
